js: (() => { const sel = ['#toolbar','#sidebar','#main','#home','#library','#reader','.btn','.lx-card','#aa-popover','dialog','.popover','.notice','.toast']; const out = {anims: document.getAnimations().map(a => [a.animationName||a.transitionProperty||a.constructor.name, a.effect?.getTiming?.().duration, a.effect?.getTiming?.().easing, a.effect?.target?.id||a.effect?.target?.className]).slice(0,20)}; for (const s of sel) { const e = document.querySelector(s); if (e) { const c = getComputedStyle(e); out[s] = {t: c.transition.slice(0,160), a: c.animationName, font: c.font.slice(0,80)}; } } return JSON.stringify(out); })()
(() => { const f = document.getElementById('reader'); const w = f?.contentWindow; w?.scrollBy(0, 1400); return w ? w.scrollY : 'no frame'; })()

(() => { const sel = ['#toolbar','#sidebar','#main','#home','#library','#reader','.btn','.lx-card','#aa-popover','dialog','.popover','.notice','.toast']; const out = {anims: document.getAnimations().map(a => [a.animationName||a.transitionProperty||a.constructor.name, a.effect?.getTiming?.().duration, a.effect?.getTiming?.().easing, a.effect?.target?.id||a.effect?.target?.className]).slice(0,20)}; for (const s of sel) { const e = document.querySelector(s); if (e) { const c = getComputedStyle(e); out[s] = {t: c.transition.slice(0,160), a: c.animationName, font: c.font.slice(0,80)}; } } return JSON.stringify(out); })()

(() => { const n = document.querySelector('#overview-text svg g.node, #overview-text [data-component], #overview-text .node'); if (!n) return 'no node'; for (const t of ['pointerover','mouseover','mouseenter']) n.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(t, {bubbles: true})); return n.outerHTML.slice(0,200); })()
